hints.title: Collection Emptiness Inspection
hints.text: Checking whether a dictionary or array possesses zero items requires checking array length or key presence.

hints.title: Fast Short-Circuit Loop
hints.text: Using for-in loop immediately returns false on the first enumerable key. Alternatively, check Array.isArray length or Object.keys length.

hints.title: Emptiness Blueprint
hints.text: For (const _ in obj) return false; return true.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: for-in loop short-circuits on the very first key without allocating arrays.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Object.keys(obj).length allocates a brand new array of strings, wasting memory on large objects.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: for-in short-circuit avoids memory allocation entirely.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Constant time short-circuit check without allocating temporary arrays.
